g.text: Check and grant the daily AI allowance
Step "draft" done, with its word count
Retrieve passages from the attached documents
Stream the routing call, with the write_to_article tool
Step "thinking" done, the answer streams as Markdown
Read the answer in the panel
Continue the turn with the tool's result
Record the interaction and settle the tokens of both calls
The steps collapse into one finished run
The routing call may run at most three steps: decide, call the tool,
recap. Each stage is reported only once it has actually run, so the
panel shows the real pipeline, not an animation. A Stop still bills
an estimate of what was produced.
